decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The size, bulk and design of the proposed building and the small size of the amenity area would be out of character with and thereby detrimental to the streetscene and The Butts Conservation Area. It would thereby be contrary to Policies ENV.1.1 and ENV 1.2 of the Adopted Unitary Development Plan (1996) and Policies ENV-B.1.1 and ENV- B.2.2 of the Proposed Unitary Development Plan (2001).

Condition : 2 - The development does not provide a replacement for a recently felled large and attractive tree with a similarly sized tree in a similarly prominent position. This is contrary to Policies ENV-N.2.7 and ENV-N.2.8 of the Proposed Unitary Development Plan (2001) and Policies ENV.1.9 and ENV.1.10 of the Adopted Unitary Development Plan (1996).

Condition : 3 - The proposed development would result in the loss of garage parking spaces, the underprovision of parking spaces for the proposed house and no pedestrian visibility splays would be provided. This would result in a reduction in pedestrian and highway safety in this area and would be contrary to policies T.1.4, T.2.2 and T.4.4 of the Proposed Unitary Development Plan and Policies T.2.5, T.3.5 and T.3.6 of the Adopted Unitary Development Plan (1996).

Condition : 4 - The proposal would lead to a significant loss of privacy to the gardens of the occupiers of adjoining properties. It would thereby be contrary to Policies ENV.1.1 and H.1.2 of the Adopted Unitary Development Plan (1996) and Policies ENV-B.1.1, H.4.1 of the Proposed Unitary Development Plan (2001).
description: Demolition of existing residential garage and erection of 2 storey 3 bedroomed dwellinghouse with integeral garage.
